title: Judge followups
description: Findings the judges propose for a change: <change-root>/followups.json, written with `exo change record <change> --followup`. Judges never fix anything themselves; the person fixes each followup (then `exo change record <change> --fixed <id>` marks it) or dismisses it in the AI Usage Record (dismissed_followups).

id.description: J<judge code>-<n>, unique in the change, for example JSEC-1 or JCR-2.

rule.description: The rule, OWASP category or criterion behind the finding.

location.description: path:line, when the finding points at code.

fixed.description: true once the finding was fixed; written with `exo change record <change> --fixed <id>`.
